groups.name: spring.actor
groups.description: Actor system settings. The typed keys (spring.actor.name, spring.actor.provider, spring.actor.remote.*, spring.actor.cluster.*, spring.actor.shutdown.timeout) set the matching Pekko keys. Any Pekko key can also be set raw under spring.actor.pekko.* (for example spring.actor.pekko.loglevel): it is passed to Pekko with the spring.actor prefix removed, and it wins over a typed key that sets the same Pekko key, with a warning. Comma-separated raw values are turned into lists.
